plugins.name: mvave
plugins.description: Control M-VAVE pedals (MK-300 profile) over USB (SysEx) from Claude: presets, models, knobs, block on/off, globals, re-amp. Two skills: mvave (configure the pedal) and tone-builder (a song's tone as a preset).
